snippet.title: Voids Vigil - Trailer
snippet.description:
Blast and dodge your way through robotic hordes in this auto-battler arena shooter. Make use of auto-firing guns and drones, timely dashes and special abilities to reach The Void where a randomly constructed final Conservator awaits convergence.

Find out more here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2738940/Voids_Vigil/

Thanks to Karl Casey for trailer music: ‪@WhiteBatAudio‬
